item.title: Spheres within spheres: A journey through many dimensions
item.description: We guide you through an exciting recent breakthrough in the world of topology, involving something called the telescope conjecture.

item.title: Meat free meat with maths
item.description: Don't like plant-based meat alternatives, but want to spare animals and the environment? There's hope on the horizon, aided by a good helping of maths.

item.title: Climate change: How can maths help?
item.description: As COP28, the 2023 United Nations Climate Change Conference, kicks off we look at how maths can help understand the climate crisis.

item.title: Contagious maths
item.description: How does maths help in tackling infectious diseases? Join Julia Gog to find out in this series of videos and articles, and have a go at modelling diseases yourself!

item.title: The murmuration conjecture: finding new maths with AI
item.description: Yang-Hui He tells us about his exciting new conjecture that came about due to both artificial and human intelligence, and reveals patterns in the prime numbers that look like flocks of birds.

item.title: GO-Science National Numeracy Day challenge!
item.description: We're helping the Government Office for Science (GO Science) to bring you an Olympic challenge for National Numeracy Day!

item.title: Groups: The basics
item.description: Group theory is the mathematics of symmetry and structure. On this page, find out what a group is and how to think about them.

item.title: Happy Ada Lovelace Day 2025!
item.description: We celebrate by revisiting some of the articles and podcasts we produced with women mathematicians over the last year.

item.title: Dark stars
item.description: Gravitational waves have provided a wealth of information about black holes. But could other objects be hiding in this data too? Researchers are exploring this idea, which may also help resolve the mystery of dark matter.

item.title: The Abel Prize 2026: Gerd Faltings
item.description: This year's Abel Prize has been awarded to the German mathematician Gerd Faltings for work that brings together number theory and geometry to solve equations.
